approach: Lives approach: this slice is the people something happened to this Cycle — a birth, a death in the house, a hospital stay, a retirement, a promotion; a household set up or a place of their own; a win or a loss on the book; the people a turn of the city reached and what it did to their day; and the smaller moments the record kept. Each person gets their own passage: the event, then the thread under it — the stay or strain that led there, the other lines the record kept for them, what the Tribune or this page already said of them, and what they did next if the record says. Read the thread in order and name where two lines of it do not agree; do not restate a ledger value as the story. The fact exactly right; never a trend, never a number first; the person, not the system the event belongs to. Facts on this slice: the names, places, roles and numbers listed. Those are real; do not invent people or places. Everything else about this beat — what it looks like, who is there, what they want and hate — is yours to paint.
